source_issue.title: Polish documentation renames, and overall shape

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on refining the documentation for the Plone project, particularly addressing renames and the overall quality of the "Contributing..." section, which still reflects some outdated references from Volto.

## What needs to be done
- Review the current "Contributing..." section and update any misleading references, specifically the mention of "Seven."
- Verify links, particularly the one for Storybook, to ensure they redirect correctly.
- Make overall improvements to clarity and accessibility of the documentation.

## Helpful background
The documentation resides at [Plone Aurora Documentation](https://plone-aurora.readthedocs.io/). This is a beginner-friendly issue ideal for new contributors, designated with labels like "good first issue" and "hacktoberfest."

## Good first steps
1. Visit the documentation to familiarize yourself with the current "Contributing..." section and take notes on areas needing updates.
2. Check the storybook link mentioned in the comments to confirm it directs correctly.
3. Suggest specific wording changes in the comments of this issue for review. Don’t hesitate to ask questions if something is unclear!
